::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 2nd [1876 or earlier]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection
:::

My dear Miss Butler[^1]

It is very kind of you and Mrs Butler but I believe [Miss Mackenzie](people/person_930.qmd)is likely to come to me immediately after Lownie’s visit, and as there have been some difficulties about her coming before I could not put it off again.

This is a hurried day so I must only write my thanks

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Evidently before the death of Anne Mackenzie in February 1877.
[^2]: This letter may be addressed to [Anna Butler](people/person_237.qmd), the sister of CMY's friend the Rev. William Butler, Vicar of Wantage.
